# R4.5b — Gateway-backed `ModelPort` on the run path, one HTTP/1.1 codec home, `HttpModelTransport` — first live run on local Ollama

Spec: `docs/tickets/154b_R4.5b__gateway-model-port-local-live.md` (seq 154b).
Depends on R4.5a (live-evidence framework, ADR-0363) + HUMAN-H6 (local NAMEs provisioned).
Requirement ids: **DF-S1.18-1** (live `Transport` member — local-HTTP family discharged; dated progress note appended, row stays OPEN for R4.5d/R4.5e's hosted families, `probe_profile` and live-signal arms) · **BL-31** (local leg discharged; hosted legs remain) · **ADR-0364** (one HTTP/1.1 codec home) · **DF-S2.4-2** (TLS — R4.5c's; `https:` refuses typed `tls_pending`).

## Summary

The production model lane is landed. A `model_port` slot binding
(`dialect: openai-compatible@1`, `endpoint`/`model` by `env:` indirection or
literal) arms `GatewayModel` (`hh-embed`), which assembles the request through
the realized dialect document, resolves credentials through `CredentialPort`
(`NoCredentials` on the local leg), sends over `HttpModelTransport`
(plain-HTTP loopback; `https:` → `UnsupportedFeature{tls_pending}`), decodes
streaming frames into `ModelOutcome`, and deposits `hh.model_io/1` blobs
through `StoreSeam` before the terminal row (durable-before-visible). Unbound
runs keep the scripted `EmbedModel` lane byte-identically.

The live leg executed for real: `scripts/live-verify.sh local-run` →
**pass** — `r45b_live_ollama_run_ledger_verify_replay` green against local
Ollama (run-1792605713479: 5 real `model.call.completed` rounds
`stop_reason=tool_use`, ledger `verify` ok, deterministic replay byte-identical
`mode: deterministic`). Evidence record:
`docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-21-local-run.json` (`result: "pass"`, USD 0
spend) + redacted transcript
`docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-21-local-run.transcript.txt`.

## What changed

- **`hh-wire::http`** — the one HTTP/1.1 codec home (ADR-0301 D1) extended with
  the client send halves: `write_request`, response head-then-body read
  (`Content-Length`/`chunked`/close-delimited), `parse_http_url`/`connect`
  (+528). The two private copies — `hh-env::egress` `LocalHttpTransport` and
  `hh-mcp::http` client helpers — are re-pointed onto it; no third codec.
- **`hh-gateway`** — `dialects::openai_compatible()` built-in dialect document
  (+206), `openai.rs` chat.completions ⇄ dialect-vocabulary `WireFrame`
  translator (+545), `http_transport.rs` `HttpModelTransport: Transport` with
  `discover` (OpenAI-compatible `/models` listing), streaming →
  `(arrival_ms, WireFrame)`, `https:` → typed `tls_pending` refusal (+267).
- **`hh-embed`** — `gateway_model.rs` `GatewayModel: ModelPort` (+945): dialect
  request assembly, `CredentialPort` (`NoCredentials` local), frames →
  `ModelOutcome` (stop reason, parsed calls, usage on `completed`);
  `model_port` slot decode in `open.rs` persisted to `manifest.extra
  ["model_lane"]` (resume re-derives); `service.rs` run-path selection —
  realized binding → `GatewayModel`, unbound → scripted lane unchanged.
- **`hh-control` driver** — three signature-stable `ModelPort` default-empty
  hooks: `requested_members` (plan facts on `model.call.requested`),
  `terminal_members` (usage/timing/served_model on `completed`/`failed`),
  `take_model_io` (canonical `hh.model_io/1` blobs deposited through
  `sink.store_seam().put_blob` *before* the terminal row lands).

## Three root causes fixed (found by the live proof leg)

The live run exposed — and this change fixes — three replay-fidelity defects
that were unverifiable without an executed live leg:

1. **Replay cue ordering** — `RecordedInputs` gained `external_events` +
   seq-marked `external_cues`; `Driver::release_due_replay_cues` injects
   scheduled cues at their recorded append-time marks so a mid-drive
   `HumanInput` lands ahead of the same iteration's internal pushes, exactly
   as live (queue-position fidelity).
2. **Envelope stamp parity** — `ReplaySink` mirrors `KernelSink`'s
   provenance/`fencing_token` stamps so `view_hash`/`checkpoint_ref` folds see
   identical content between live and replay.
3. **Recorded `assembly_ms`** — the recorded `assembly_ms` substitution vector
   replays the live-measured value rather than re-deriving it; `ReplaySink`
   lays the recorded seq lattice and flushes non-driver rows just-in-time.
